newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Nov 1st 10 days trade surplus up 104.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Japan Nov 1st 10 days trade surplus up 104.4 pct.

text.p: Japan's customs-cleared trade surplus rose 104.4 percent to 202.45 billion yen in the first 10 days of November compared with a revised surplus of 99.03 billion yen in the same period a year earlier, the Finance Ministry announced on Monday.
Free-on-board (FOB) exports rose 0.5 percent to 1.12 trillion yen from a year earlier, while cost, insurance and freight (CIF) imports dropped 9.6 percent to 919.31 billion yen.
